title: The first per-mode targets from the published splits (9.205)

B.targets.published_split_area.description: Which published daily mode split (data/processed/observed/published_mode_splits.csv) the targets derive from: the MMR, the study core (D13), as the CTS Updation surveyed it.

B.targets.published_split_year.description: The survey year of the published split used: 2017, the CTS Updation household survey - the newest all-mode observation of the MMR the package holds.

sweep.basis: the CTS prints the active share as "about 47 %"; the sweep on every derived target carries the rounding of that statement, and its own width is the reading of "about"

B.targets.active_share_sweep_pp.description: How far the printed "about 47 %" active share may sit from 47 in either direction; propagated to every target derived from the motorised split.

B.targets.ferry_port_groups.description: The Maharashtra Maritime Board port groups whose routes lie in the MMR (Bandra: Versova-Madh and the Mumbai creek routes; Mora: the harbour routes to Uran and Elephanta); Rajpuri, Ratnagiri and Vengurla are outside the study extent.

held_fixed.rule: a published screenline observation (CMP for Greater Mumbai executive summary, traffic composition), never varied
held_fixed.departure_requires: a newer classified count at the screenlines

B.targets.goods_vehicle_traffic_share_pc.description: Goods vehicles as a share of screenline traffic, the CMP for Greater Mumbai's traffic composition (buses 4.4 %, goods vehicles 11.5 %): the level the truck row prints beside the modelled network-wide road-vehicle share.
